summary: Smoke Tree RV Park (Bakersfield): DROP CANDIDATE - a long-term RV community (first month free, monthly/seasonal rates, 'application process' for every stay) with no posted nightly rate or booking site anywhere; Google 3.3 (74).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay park; reviewer's call): the operator markets long-term living only - 'First Month Free', 'Whether you’re staying for a month, a season, or longer', 'Designed for Long-Term RV Living', 'staying for a month, a season, or indefinitely, our affordable monthly rates' - and booking runs through 'the application process for both short-term and long-term stays'. No nightly rate is posted on any page and there is no booking engine (the 2026-10-16 price pass found none either), so it fails the 'leans long-stay needs a posted nightly rate or booking site' test. 'Short-term visitors' are mentioned, but only in boilerplate. Nightly share unmeasured. Google 3.3 (74 reviews), with tenancy and rent-increase complaints.

If kept: hookups 30/50 amp full hookups confirmed by the operator; covered spaces for 'up to 29’ Trailers'; laundry, pool, clubhouse, dog park; phone (661) 831-6154 matches; no price, so the price gate can't be run.
note: Gated private RV park at 4435 Hughes Lane, Bakersfield, mainly serving monthly and long-term residents; paved sites, pool, clubhouse, BBQ area and dog park, and covered spaces for trailers up to 29 ft. --Claude
